name: Entheogen
summary: Entheogen is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

uses.text: Entheogens (from the Ancient Greek ἔνθεος entheos ["god", "divine"] and γενέσθαι genesthai ["generate" - "generating the divine within"]) are a family of psychoactive substances, typically of plant origin, that are used in religious, ritual, or spiritual contexts.

summaryZh: 宗教致幻劑（英語：entheogen）是指在宗教、巫覡宗敎或者精神領域使用的精神藥品。
summaryZhHans: 宗教致幻剂（英语：entheogen）是指在宗教、巫觋宗敎或者精神领域使用的精神药品。
